summary: Iteration 3 (P1) testing complete. Backend: 9/9 new pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py covering (a) login rate limiting: 5 fails -> 401, 6th -> 429, per-identifier scoping (locked email does not block admin), successful login clears counters, email-only fallback catches X-Forwarded-For rotation (4 distinct IPs + 1 different -> 429). (b) PATCH /api/projects/{id}: admin partial update returns full project with only provided fields changed and untouched fields preserved + GET-verified persistence; client -> 403; unauth -> 401; non-existent id -> 404; empty body -> 400. Iter1+iter2 regression: 22/22 still pass. Frontend: Admin login + /admin nav verified, edit (pencil) opens pre-filled form, submit text reads 'Save Changes' (CSS-uppercased), title/desc/loc/year/desc pre-populated; changing title+desc and submitting triggers PATCH, toast 'Project "..." updated.' appears, table row reflects new title; subsequent 'New Project' click opens blank form with 'Create Project' button; updated title appears on public /portfolio. Cleanup: login_attempts collection emptied at end so admin/client are not locked out.
action_items: Optional: re-seed or restore the 'Maple Ridge Residence' project description. It was already modified to 'Updated description via PATCH test' (34 chars) before iteration 3 testing began, likely from a manual PATCH verification. Seed only inserts when collection is empty, so it won't self-heal. Either run a one-time UPDATE to the canonical seed description, or make the seed an idempotent upsert.
Optional code cleanup: button label 'Save Changes'/'Create Project' is rendered uppercase by Tailwind class via CSS; tests must compare case-insensitively. Not a bug, but documenting for next agent.
Optional: brute-force counters live in MongoDB; consider TTL index on login_attempts.failed_at (e.g., expire after 24h) so the collection cannot grow unboundedly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _check_lockout / _record_failed_login use ISO-string timestamps and compare with $gte against an ISO string. Works because ISO-8601 is lexically sortable in UTC, but storing as native BSON datetime + a TTL index on failed_at would be cleaner and auto-prune old rows (currently the collection grows forever).

server.py login: identifier 'unknown:email' is used when client_ip cannot be derived (no XFF, no request.client). This is fine but means anonymous proxies bypassing XFF land in a shared 'unknown' bucket. The email-only fallback identifier still catches it -- OK.

ProjectPatch model allows setting 'images' to an empty list which is treated as a real update (good), but {k: v for k,v in payload.model_dump().items() if v is not None} will SKIP an explicit `featured=False` only if the user sends null. Since pydantic only emits None for unset, this is correct -- documenting for clarity.
Admin.jsx createProject() handler is now used for both POST and PATCH; rename to saveProject() for readability.

Admin.jsx after PATCH the form is auto-closed (resetForm). If user wants to make a second edit they must scroll back. Consider keeping the form open in 'edit mode' with the just-saved data still loaded, or showing a 'View on portfolio' link in the success toast.
